description: An HTML file that presents the Dylan language mode for CodeMirror, including the embedded Dylan source code defining locator classes, methods, and protocols used for file and directory location abstractions.

classes.name: <directory-locator>
classes.description: Abstract class representing a directory locator in Dylan.

classes.name: <file-locator>
classes.description: Abstract class representing a file locator in Dylan.

methods.name: as
methods.description: Converts a native locator to a string or vice versa depending on class.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Constructs locator objects with specified attributes.

methods.name: locator-test
methods.description: Returns a test function for directory locators.

methods.name: locator-might-have-links?
methods.description: Checks if a directory locator might have links.

methods.name: current-directory-locator?
methods.description: Checks if a directory locator is the current directory.

methods.name: simplify-locator
methods.description: Simplifies a locator to its canonical form.

methods.name: subdirectory-locator
methods.description: Creates a locator for a subdirectory.

methods.name: relative-locator
methods.description: Computes a relative locator from one locator to another.

methods.name: supports-open-locator?
methods.description: Checks whether a file locator supports opening.

methods.name: open-locator
methods.description: Opens a locator as a stream.
